analysis:
## Technical analysis

### August 26, 2026 — The Earnings Binary Night

The regular session was the quietest of the Gate 3 period: NVDA closed at $213.04 (+$0.75 / +0.35%), range $212.16-$214.03 ($1.87 wide vs Aug 25's $4.72 and Aug 24's $7.32). The 20-DMA (~$214.62) capped the session high at $214.03 for the THIRD consecutive session. Volume was ~65M shares — the lightest of Gate 3. Classic pre-earnings holding pattern: every account waiting for the binary. The session's story is entirely the POST-CLOSE earnings release.

### Q2 FY2027 Earnings — The Numbers

| Metric | Actual | Consensus | Beat |
|--------|--------|-----------|------|
| Revenue | $96.22B | $92.17B | +$4.05B / +4.4% |
| EPS (adj) | $2.22 | $2.10 | +$0.12 / +5.7% |
| Data Center | $89.0B | $85.7B | +$3.3B / +3.8% |
| Q3 Revenue Guide | $108.0B | $103.96B | +$4.04B / +3.9% |
| FY2028 Growth | 70% | 44% | +26 percentage points |

### The FY2028 70% Guidance — Why This Is the Key Number

FY2027 consensus revenue: $394.4B. At 70% growth: $394.4B × 1.70 = **$670.5B** FY2028. At prior 44% consensus: $567.9B. The guidance implies **$102.6B above** what analysts modeled for FY2028. This is not a modest beat — it is a full re-rating of NVIDIA's revenue trajectory for the next fiscal year. It tells the market that demand for Blackwell and Vera Rubin platforms is not only sustained but accelerating into 2027, and that the AI server TAM is expanding faster than even the most bullish analyst models captured.

### Trend — All Three Moving Averages Below AH Price

| Average | Level | AH ~$223 | Status |
|---------|-------|---------|--------|
| 20-DMA | ~$214.62 | Above by ~$8.38 | CLEARED |
| 50-DMA | ~$209.60 | Above by ~$13.40 | WELL CLEAR |
| 200-DMA | ~$196.81 | Above by ~$26.19 | WELL CLEAR |

For the first time since the Aug 14 rally peak, all three moving averages are below the current price. The 20-DMA — which capped three consecutive regular sessions as a ceiling — was erased in the first post-earnings tick. Role reversal: it now becomes the primary support level.

### ★ Strongest Support — $215-$215.50 (Former 20-DMA, Now Support Floor)

1. **Role reversal**: Two consecutive regular sessions, NVDA's session high stopped at the 20-DMA (Aug 24: $215.90, Aug 25: $214.73). Three sessions where it was the ceiling. Post-earnings, this ceiling becomes the floor — the most durable form of support
2. **Rising**: The 20-DMA rises ~$0.50/day; by Aug 27 it will be ~$215.12, maintaining its position as the primary post-earnings support
3. **What breaks it**: A regular-session close below $215 on heavy volume (100M+ shares) within 5 sessions of the earnings would signal the AH gap is being rejected; conviction would drop to BUY MEDIUM

### ★ Strongest Resistance — $232-$234 (Straddle Upper Break-Even)

1. **Mechanical resistance**: Pre-earnings straddle priced at $18-$20/share (break-even approximately $192-$232); straddle holders sell the call leg at the upper break-even, creating systematic selling pressure
2. **Scale**: The $215 calls had peak open interest entering earnings; mass position closure at the upper break-even creates concentrated supply
3. **Gap from AH**: $232 is $9-$11 above the AH ~$223 — achievable in one strong regular session but faces this mechanical wall
4. **Beyond $234**: If $232-$234 clears, the 52-week high ($236.54) is the next wall — only $2.54 above $234

### Volume — Pre-Earnings Compression Ending

~65M shares in the regular session is the lightest of Gate 3 — exactly what a pre-earnings holding day looks like. The volume will reverse at Aug 27 open:
- **Bullish scenario**: 80-100M+ shares, gap open above $220, hold above $220 on close = confirmed high-conviction follow-through
- **IV crush dynamic**: Options market makers shift from short-gamma hedging (pre-earnings: sell on rallies, buy on dips) to long-delta positioning (post-earnings: buy on dips) — this mechanically supports any intraday pullbacks

### RSI and Momentum

Pre-earnings RSI was 49.61 (neutral, fading from the Aug 14 peak). A gap from $213 to $223+ adds approximately 10-12 RSI points, likely pushing toward 60-65 at the Aug 27 open (bullish momentum zone). The MACD histogram (negative at -1.26 pre-earnings) will cross to positive on the Aug 27 open. Momentum resets from neutral/bearish to bullish in a single session.

### Pattern: Earnings Gap into Previously Failed Resistance

The pre-earnings setup created a textbook 'gap through resistance' pattern:
- The 20-DMA ($214.62) capped three consecutive regular sessions
- The triple-bottom zone ($219.74-$224.86) was the overhead supply
- The earnings gap from $213.04 regular close to ~$223 AH simultaneously clears both resistance levels
- This is the most constructive post-earnings technical resolution — resistance levels that took three sessions to fail in regular trading are cleared in a single AH print

### What Would Change the Read

**Maintain BUY HIGH**: Aug 27 regular session closes above $215 on any volume — the AH gap holds and momentum is confirmed on a closing basis.

**Downgrade to BUY MEDIUM**: Aug 27 regular session closes below $215 on heavy volume (100M+ shares) — 'sell the news' reversal erases the AH gain; Gate 3 still active, conviction drops because the gap failed.

**Downgrade to BUY LOW**: Regular-session close below $209 (50-DMA breach) — extremely unlikely given the 70% FY2028 guide; would signal sellers overwhelming structural demand.

**Step Aside**: Regular-session close below $200 — Gate 1 trigger; ~$23 / ~10.3% buffer from AH ~$223; requires a series of severe external shocks.
